description: The Google Ads accounts this organization may work in, each with customer_id, the name it was given, and may_change: true when changes can be proposed in it, false when it is yours to read and report on only. Start here: every other call names one of these customer_id values, and an account that is not listed is answered as though it did not exist. -- MakeHybrid API plan, GET /google-ads/v1/accounts, group google-ads.
